title: HB 2847 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, permits the use of a photo identification card issued by this state, the United States, or an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state for purposes of verifying the identity of an eligible voter. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(c)(2) (Sec. 1, replaces subdivision (2))
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) 2-7-112(c)(8) new (Sec. 2)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 3: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: 2123899-Draft: carries slot a (adds postsecondary-institution photo ID to 2-7-112(c); restates (c)(2)); lead House sponsor on the file is Hodges.
(other) version: 2143920-Draft: operative words identical to the 2123899 Draft; only the sponsor line differs (Hardaway).
(other) note: Two Drafts, same operative text; the quotes are from the second. Failed in House Elections & Campaign Finance Subcommittee 2020-03-11; no roll call saved. Companion SB2448 identical.
